name: Deepgram
description: Deepgram is a cutting-edge speech recognition and transcription service that leverages advanced AI and deep learning technologies to deliver highly accurate and fast transcriptions. Ideal for businesses and developers looking to integrate powerful voice-to-text capabilities into their applications.
